name: checkapp
description: AI content quality gate — plagiarism, AI detection, SEO, fact-check, tone, legal risk, and more. CLI + web dashboard.
author: Sharon Sciammas

scripts.test: bun test src/*.test.ts src/audit/*.test.ts src/skills/*.test.ts src/utils/*.test.ts src/providers/*.test.ts src/cli/*.test.ts src/cost/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts tests/e2e/*.test.ts tests/golden/*.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:browser: bun test tests/e2e/browser/boot.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/cli-smokes.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/dashboard-tier-routing.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/mcp-smokes.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/ui-check-form.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/ui-contexts-page.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/ui-deep-audit-csrf.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/ui-localized-audit-report.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/ui-reports-page.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/ui-settings-tier-selector.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/ui-skills-page.test.ts tests/e2e/browser/ui-theme-toggle.test.ts
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:dashboard
scripts.test:release: bun run test && bun run test:dashboard && bun run check:registry && bun run check:docs && bun run check:package && cd dashboard && bunx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && bun run build && cd .. && bun run test:e2e:browser:prod && bun run test:e2e:browser && bun run build
scripts.test:release:extended: bun run test:release && bun run test:gemini-grounded:scenarios
